lines.say: Why do some people grow faster?
In one study, hundreds of people did the same twelve-week arm program.
Some grew their biceps by more than half. Others barely grew at all. Same plan.
Genes play a part: your hormones, how many muscle stem cells you have, and how your body responds to training.
But low responders usually still improve with more volume, more time, or a different program.
So don't compare your week ten to someone's year ten. Compare you to the old you.
Your genes set the speed, not the finish line.
